seo.title: Pricing — Meecrogate editions
seo.description: Meecrogate pricing: four editions, all five components included, unlimited instances and calls, free non-production. Count your APIs and the number is published.

hero.title: Count your APIs. That is the whole quote.
hero.subtitle: One edition covers all five components, every instance and every call. A single annual number, which you can forecast for every year of the contract.

items.title: No per-call pricing
items.description: Your bill does not move because your traffic did.

items.title: No per-instance pricing
items.description: Pods, replicas and nodes are never counted. Scale freely.

items.title: Everything in the box
items.description: All five components in every edition, Control Station included.

items.title: One number, not a matrix
items.description: Your APIs and your production environments: that is all the calculation takes.

editions.title: One number covers the whole platform
editions.subtitle: Pick the edition that matches the number of APIs you publish and the production environments you run. Everything else is included.

launch.name: Launch
launch.description: First production APIs for one team or one business unit.

business.name: Business
business.description: A department-wide API platform. The volume most first enterprise deals land on.

scale.name: Scale
scale.description: Several domains in production, with a second production environment for isolation or region.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Group-wide platform. Unlimited APIs and production environments, custom SLA, dedicated team.

editions.footnote: One API is one API product exposed to consumers — with any number of routes, versions, operations and backends behind it. One production environment is one logical platform, whatever the number of instances, nodes or zones it runs on. Multi-year commitments carry a discount.

included.title: Every edition, no exceptions
included.subtitle: The things competitors meter — instances, calls, non-production, the console — are simply included here.

rows.detail: API Gateway, Identity Server, Orchestrator, Process Executor and Control Station.
Pods, replicas and nodes are never counted. Scale as far as your cluster allows.
No per-call charge, no request bundles, no overage.
Every dev, test, QA and staging environment is free.
Administration console and developer portal, for the whole platform.

rows.item: Standard support and a published SLA
rows.detail: Ticket-based, business hours, with committed first-response times. Premium 24/7 is included with Enterprise.
Fixes, security patches and every new release, for the term of the subscription.

addons.title: Four add-ons, one rule each
addons.subtitle: No per-edition matrix and no negotiation table. Each add-on follows a single rule that applies to every edition, and we price it with you.

items.title: Extra APIs
items.description: Publishing more APIs than your edition includes? They are added in packs. And as soon as the larger edition becomes cheaper, we move you there.

items.title: Extra production environment
items.description: A second active region, a subsidiary, an isolated estate: one more production platform, with unlimited instances inside it, as always.

items.title: Premium 24/7 support
items.description: Round-the-clock coverage of critical incidents, hotline and dedicated escalation channel. Included with the Enterprise edition.

items.title: SaaS operation
items.description: We host and operate the platform: hosting, patching, upgrades and monitoring. Same product, same configuration as on-premise.

addons.note: On-premise is the baseline: you operate it, and the edition stays the only recurring platform cost.

rules.title: Three promises, held by the model
rules.subtitle: Most billing surprises come from three places: traffic, scaling and test environments. Here, none of the three counts.

items.label: Traffic
items.note: No per-call charge, no request bundles, no overage. Your bill does not follow your traffic curve.

items.label: Scaling
items.note: High availability and autoscaling cost nothing extra. Scale as far as your cluster allows.

items.label: Non-production
items.note: Dev, test, QA and staging cost nothing. Most competitors bill non-production at full or half rate.

predictability.title: Three figures, and you have the number
predictability.subtitle: Nothing depends on traffic, users, calls or pods. Given your own API roadmap, every year of the contract is known before it is signed.

steps.title: Count your published APIs
steps.description: One API product, however many routes and versions sit behind it. An API counts once, even when deployed in several regions.

steps.title: Count your production environments
steps.description: Non-production does not count — it is free and unlimited.

steps.title: Choose your commitment term
steps.description: 1, 3 or 5 years. The longer the term, the larger the discount, and the price is locked for the whole of it.

cta.label: Your number
cta.title: Give us those three figures
cta.description: We send back the annual number, what it becomes over the committed term and exactly what it covers — in one conversation, with no quotation cycle.

build.title: Implementation and run, by the same teams
build.subtitle: The recurring integration work is catalogued at a fixed price: a new orchestrator or a new identity connection never needs a quotation cycle.

items.title: Getting started
items.description: Deployment onto your infrastructure, connection of your identity provider, onboarding of your first APIs.

items.title: Fixed-price project
items.description: Framing, design, build and go-live, across nine work packages and five payment milestones.

items.title: Run and maintenance
items.description: Application maintenance, run assistance and an annual envelope of days you draw down as needed.

build.note: The same teams that build the product can integrate it, advise on it and support it — one contract, one accountable party. Integration delivered by Yupiik IT services.

items.question: What counts as an API?
items.answer: One API product exposed to consumers, with any number of routes, versions, operations and backends behind it. That is deliberately more generous than vendors who meter each service separately. An API deployed in several production environments counts once.

items.question: What counts as a production environment?
items.answer: One logical Meecrogate platform serving production traffic: one deployment in one cloud region, or in one datacentre. The number of instances, pods, nodes or availability zones never enters into it, and a passive standby site is included.

items.question: Do you bill for instances, pods or calls?
items.answer: No. Pods, replicas and nodes are never counted, and there is no per-call charge and no overage. The licence metric is the production environment.

items.question: What happens if I outgrow my edition's APIs?
items.answer: Extra APIs are added in packs, at one rate that applies to every edition. The model is built so that the larger edition becomes cheaper before packs pile up: we move you there, pro-rated, with no cap and nothing to watch.

items.question: Are dev, test and QA environments billed?
items.answer: No. Non-production is free and unlimited, whichever edition you are on.

items.question: Is the Control Station charged separately?
items.answer: Never. The administration console and developer portal are included in every edition.

items.question: Are updates included?
items.answer: Yes. Fixes, security patches and new releases are included for the term of the subscription, with a published SLA on support response times.

items.question: Can you operate the platform for us?
items.answer: Yes. SaaS operation by Meecrogate covers hosting, patching, upgrades and monitoring, with the same product and the same configuration as on-premise. You can move either way.

items.question: Can we buy a single component?
items.answer: It is possible, for à-la-carte and for tenders that require it. From two components on, the edition costs less and carries more. Let's talk about your scope.

items.question: Can we start with a pilot?
items.answer: Yes. The typical pilot — one business unit, around ten APIs, one production environment — runs on the Launch edition, with the matching integration from the catalogue. Let's talk.

notes.label: Notes:
notes.text: All prices are in <0>EUR excluding VAT, per year</0>. VAT is charged on top at the prevailing rate. Licences are invoiced annually in advance, payable 60 days from invoice date. Edition prices are locked for the committed term. This page is indicative and does not constitute a commercial offer.
